evidence: Contingency table of PhD counts by type, sex and citizen, each cell once; count and count11 are the two survey years of a fixed-cell table, no unit the rows repeat within.
instruction and expectation are fixed design factors; the experimenter who collected each batch of ratings is not a column, so no column indexes a repeated unit.
One row per city; region is a fixed four-level attribute (E, MW, S, W) and Fox fits a single-level regression of moral on hetero and mobility.
One row per arrestee; year is the calendar year of arrest in police records, a covariate as Fox models it, not a survey wave, and checks is a count.
pretest.1 and pretest.2 then post.test.1 to post.test.3 are each student's test scores before and after instruction as columns; group is the fixed teaching method.
One row per respondent; region is a fixed five-level classification of Chile and population the community size, a covariate, not an id.
DT1 to DT7 are each respondent's answers to the seven items of the drive-for-thinness scale as columns, a person by item structure stored wide.
early and late are each farm's depredation counts in the two periods (number their sum) as columns; longitude and latitude are coordinates.
One row per city or state; city is a fixed two-level type (city, state) and the documented model is a single-level regression of undercount.
One row per county; GORE to PHILLIPS split the county's Total vote by candidate, a contingency row, not repeated measures of a unit.
One row per subject; condition (Before, Meshed, SFR) is a fixed between-subjects design factor.

year indexes the GSS survey wave ("Data are included from the GSS for each of these years"), each holding many respondents, but Fox and Weisberg (2019, chapter 4) fit lm(vocab ~ year + educGroup + gender + nativeBorn*ageGroup), the wave fixed, so it stays excluded.
One row per four-person group ("The observations are" the groups); condition and sex are fixed design factors and cooperation sums the group's choices.
One row per highway segment; htype is a fixed road-type attribute and the documented analysis regresses rate on design variables.
One row per nation; region is a fixed four-level continent and oil a two-level attribute.
One row per subject; partner.status and fcategory are fixed factors of a factorial design, fscore a covariate.
One row per neighborhood; neighborhood is an id with one row per unit, the rest neighborhood attributes.
One row per married woman from the PSID; no column indexes a unit, Fox fits a single-level logistic regression of lfp.
One row per firm ("The names of the firms were not available"); sector and nation are fixed attributes.
Anscombe's four contrived regression datasets side by side (x with y1 to y3, x4 with y4); no unit the rows repeat within.
One row per nation; region is a fixed four-level attribute and tfr is regressed on contraceptors.
emp1 to emp52 are each convict's weekly employment status after release as columns, a time-varying covariate stored wide.
One row per professor; rank, discipline and sex are fixed attributes, no department or person id repeats.
One row per state; region is a fixed census-region attribute, SATV and SATM two different test components.
One row per bank branch; t1 and t2 count transactions of two types, no id column.
One row per country; region and group are fixed attributes, the columns national indicators.
One row per nation; region is a fixed continent, the male and female columns are distinct national indicators.
year is the "Year of the survey" of the GSS respondents ("respondents to U.S. General Social Surveys"), a survey wave each holding many respondents.
One row per respondent; country is a fixed four-level comparison (Australia, Norway, Sweden, USA) in Fox and Andersen's single-level logit, no sampled site.
wl1 to wl3 and se1 to se3 are each individual's weight loss and self esteem at one, two and three months as columns; group is the fixed treatment.
One row per household; no village or well id, Gelman and Hill's single-level logistic regression of switch.
One row per woman; region is a fixed five-level province grouping, children a two-level attribute.
One row per patient; tgrp is the fixed anaesthetic (A to D), patients measured once.
conc and lot are fixed factors of a dose-response design (lot "either one or two"); no unit the rows repeat within.
Contingency table of y counts by class71 and class81, each cell once.
id is a subject id with one row per subject; location is a two-county attribute and bp.2s, bp.2d a second blood-pressure reading of a covariate, not a repeated response.
One row per adult of the health survey; every column is an individual attribute or count.
One row per billionaire; region is a fixed five-level location attribute.
pre and post are each child's hemoglobin before and after treatment as columns; treatment and sex are fixed.
id is a student id with one row per student; read, write, math, science and socst are different subject scores and no school id is in this subset.
One row per country; region is a fixed four-level continent and oil a two-level attribute.
One row per lunar observation; group is one of the three groups Mayer formed for his least-squares-like solution, a method artifact, not a sampled unit.
Contingency table of count by tumor and site, each cell once.
One row per student; the subset holds no school id, sex, race and paredu are attributes.
One row per respondent; ClinLR and DoleLR are the respondent's placements of two different candidates, PID an ordered attribute.
Contingency table of count by parent and student usage, each cell once; student is a usage level, not an id.
year.76 to year.80 are each youth's marijuana use in five yearly waves as columns, aggregated by pattern with count.
temp and humid are fixed factors of a factorial with four snails per cell and no snail id.
One row per child; group is the fixed solution strategy (row or corner), time the response and eft a covariate.
Foster and Biological are the IQs of the two twins of one pair as columns, the pair the unit; Social is the pair's class.
Contingency table of y counts by policy, sex and year in program, each cell once.
y1, y2 and y3 are the defects in the three replicates of each run of the fractional factorial as columns.
One row per tumour case; Class is the response and the rest cell ratings, no patient id.
One row per man; the employing companies are named in the details but no company column is in the table.
Reporting-delay table of y counts cross-classified by diagnosis time and delay, each cell once.
One row per patient; group is the randomized two-level treatment.
One row per resident; sex is a fixed attribute and entry, exit, time the survival times.
l1, b1 and l2, b2 are the head length and breadth of the eldest and second son of each family as columns, the family the unit.
One row per patient; year is the year of operation, a covariate, and sex and ulcer are attributes.
brood1, brood2 and brood3 are each animal's live offspring in its three broods as columns (total their sum); conc is the dose.
One row per patient; m is a column of ones and the rest binary predictors and acid, no patient id.
